subject: Quick reminder about the fence panel
text:
Hello.
This is a reminder.
The shed fence panel.
You said Friday.
That was a month ago.
It is still open.
I know work is hard.
I do not blame you.
I just need an update.
Can you bring materials?
I can hold the post.
We can finish it fast.
The wind keeps rattling it.
My cat gets nervous.
I want it sorted.
I do not enjoy reminding.
I value good boundaries.
Please send one line.
Say yes or no.
Tell me a new date.
I will be understanding.
No guilt.
No lecture.
Just a clear reply.
I appreciate your help.
I know intentions are good.
Timing gets away from us.
Still, it is important.
I can lend clamps.
I can bring paint.
Tell me what you prefer.
If you cannot do it,
I understand fully.
Please only say so soon.
I need to plan.
Have a gentle week.
Talk soon.
Best,
